description: Rule-based catalog for turning exported Android component names into app-owner review areas. It is intentionally conservative: classification explains review context, not exploitability.

rules.groupTitle: Payment / financial redirect surfaces need review
recommendedReview: Confirm URI scheme, host, and path constraints for payment/auth return flows.
Confirm state/nonce validation before accepting callback results.
Confirm SDK configuration matches the production package name and signing certificate.

rules.groupTitle: Payment and checkout entry points need review
recommendedReview: Confirm the externally reachable payment entry point validates caller, state, and expected route.
Confirm payment completion cannot be spoofed by arbitrary intent extras or deep-link parameters.
Confirm callback routes validate state/nonce and reject unexpected callers.
Confirm token, code, and redirect parameters are not accepted without server-side validation.

rules.groupTitle: Deep link / routing entry points need review
recommendedReview: Confirm accepted schemes, hosts, paths, and parameters are constrained.
Confirm routing code rejects unexpected destinations and sensitive actions without fresh authorization.

rules.groupTitle: WebView / browser entry points need review
recommendedReview: Confirm URL loading is restricted to expected origins.
Confirm external URLs cannot reach privileged WebView settings or JavaScript bridges.

rules.groupTitle: Preview/tooling components in release artifact need review
recommendedReview: Confirm the component is intentionally shipped in the production artifact.
Remove preview/debug tooling from release builds or protect it behind an explicit guard.

rules.groupTitle: Third-party SDK exported surfaces need review
recommendedReview: Confirm SDK callbacks are expected for the app profile and release channel.
Confirm SDK configuration and privacy disclosures match enabled SDK behavior.

rules.groupTitle: Third-party SDK exported surfaces need review
recommendedReview: Confirm analytics/referrer receivers are expected and documented in privacy disclosures.
Confirm release configuration disables debug or preview-only analytics endpoints.

rules.groupTitle: Third-party SDK exported surfaces need review
recommendedReview: Confirm push/service callbacks are expected for distributed markets.
Confirm message handling validates payload type and does not trigger sensitive actions directly.

rules.groupTitle: Third-party SDK exported surfaces need review
recommendedReview: Confirm chat/messaging SDK surfaces are expected for this app profile.
Confirm privacy disclosures and notification/message handling expectations are documented.

rules.groupTitle: Third-party SDK exported surfaces need review
recommendedReview: Confirm fraud/risk SDK surfaces are expected and covered by the customer privacy story.
Confirm SDK identifiers and callbacks do not expose app-owned sensitive flows.

rules.groupTitle: Customer-data flow entry points need review
recommendedReview: Confirm externally reachable customer-data routes require the expected authenticated state.
Confirm inbound parameters cannot bypass normal navigation or authorization checks.
Confirm the component is intentionally reachable from other apps.
Confirm manifest permission guards, caller validation, and input validation are sufficient.
